summary: Read active mandates injected into new agent sessions.

help:
Usage: mandates [OPTIONS]

  Print the active mandate union (same set SessionStart hooks inject).

  Examples:
    st mandates
    st --no-compact mandates
    st --no-compact --human mandates

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

usage.when: read the active canonical mandate union
